# teams_vdi_policy (Data Source)

Look up an existing VdiPolicy object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `disable_audio_video_in_calls_and_meetings` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableAudioVideoInCallsAndMeetings parameter.
- `disable_calls_and_meetings` (Boolean) Maps to the -DisableCallsAndMeetings parameter.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `vdi2_optimization` (String) Maps to the -VDI2Optimization parameter.
